metadata.description: Curated agent skills encoding domain expertise, workflows, and high-quality execution patterns.

plugins.name: agency
plugins.description: All agency skills in one plugin, invoked as /agency:<skill>: Atlassian (Jira, Confluence, Rovo MCP setup), sales (estimates, quotations), legal (contracts and legal documents under Indonesian law by default, using Anthropic's legal plugin and the Pasal.id connector), docs (user guides and manual videos, agent instructions), dev (general coding guidelines, project initiation, including cloud environment setup scripts, React, UI/UX with mockups before new UI and a cheap browser smoke check after), DevOps (Coolify, OCI), token-saver, and context-management (per-project memory, credentials, and extensions installed as agency-<ext_name> plugins).
